# AICOM Factory Just Updated + Video

By Humanoid Deep Analyser / 3 seconds ago

AICOM Factory v2.2.2 Hardens Vercel Publishing With ATLAS Mesh Support

AICOM Factory has received a significant update with version 2.2.2, focused on making live Vercel deployments more reliable and production-ready. The release, described as “Vercel/ATLAS publish hardening,” targets the Sentinel publishing path and addresses several problems that could break deployed AI products.

ATLAS Connectivity Replaces Localhost Assumptions

One of the most important changes is the injection of the public ATLAS_BASE_URL environment variable instead of relying on localhost. This makes the factory better suited to real cloud deployments where services need to communicate across an external mesh rather than a developer’s local machine.

The release also rewrites the legacy /aimarket/invoke endpoint to the newer /ai-market/v2/invoke path, helping older factory components communicate with the current AI Market interface.

Vendored Components Become More ATLAS-Aware

✅ The release focuses on Vercel and ATLAS publishing hardening.TRUE

✅ ATLAS_BASE_URL replaces localhost-based configuration for the public ATLAS mesh.TRUE

✅ The legacy /aimarket/invoke route is rewritten to /ai-market/v2/invoke.TRUE

✅ The release adds automatic handling for pydantic-settings and bcrypt imports.TRUE

❌ There is no indication that v2.2.2 represents a completely new AICOM architecture. It is primarily an infrastructure and publishing-hardening update.FALSE

The broader release history indicates a project steadily moving from a public experimental factory toward a more reproducible and operational AI-product platform.

The strongest technical signal is the increasing emphasis on deployment gates, security checks, dependency handling, and live-service validation.

## Prediction

(+1) AICOM Factory will continue adding deployment-specific safeguards as more generated products move from local testing to public hosting.

(+1) ATLAS will likely become a more central component of the factory’s publishing and advisory infrastructure.
